auth.title: Sign in
auth.needAccount: Ask your admin to create a doctor account, or register with email.
auth.registerOk: Account created. Next, set up two-factor authentication.

auth.requiredNotice: Two-factor authentication is required for every doctor account. Patient data stays locked until setup is complete.
auth.needSecondFactor: Sign in again and enter your authenticator code.
auth.afterEnroll: Authenticator saved. Sign in with your email, password, and authenticator code.
auth.sessionExpired: For your security, sign in again with two-factor authentication.

enroll.title: Set up two-factor authentication
enroll.subtitle: Use an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator. This is required before you can open patient information.
enroll.verifyEmailBody: We sent a verification link. Open it, then return here. Two-factor setup needs a verified email.
enroll.scanBody: Open your authenticator app and scan the code, or enter the key manually.

challenge.title: Two-factor verification
challenge.subtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app to continue.
challenge.smsNativeHint: SMS backup sign-in needs phone MFA (reCAPTCHA / native). Use your authenticator app or a recovery code.
challenge.smsPreferTotp: Authenticator app is the primary method.

recovery.title: Recovery code
recovery.subtitle: Enter one unused recovery code. This signs you in once and removes your authenticator so you can set it up again.
recovery.reenrollHint: Recovery code accepted. Sign in, then set up your authenticator again.

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.subtitle: Store these codes offline. Each code works only once. They will not be shown again.
codes.onceWarning: If you lose your authenticator and these codes, you will need admin help to regain access.

biometric.title: Unlock AuricRX Médicos
biometric.subtitle: Use biometrics or your device PIN. Full two-factor sign-in is required again after 30 days, on a new device, or after sign-out.
biometric.failed: Could not unlock. Try again or sign in with password.

home.smsBackupHint: Optional SMS backup can be added after phone MFA is enabled in Firebase (see setup doc). Authenticator app remains required.
